title: Apparatus and method for performing at least one geometric dimension of an object

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes a device for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.

This reference describes a gripping means for moving an object for measurement, but not a housing with a grip portion for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not mention exhaust air discharged by a vacuum generating device being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a sound-damping device.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a sound-damping material.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.
This reference describes an apparatus and method for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a sound-reducing device or material in a housing portion.
This reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with housing portions and an air outlet.
This reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with an air collection device or screw.
This reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point.
This reference does not mention air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
This reference describes an apparatus for measuring geometric dimensions of an object, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not describe a suction plate, carrier plate, or a seal fastened to a carrier plate.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
This reference describes a gripping means for moving an object for measurement, but it does not disclose a grip unit and a suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device.

This reference describes a gripping means, which can include a retention system with suckers or pneumatic vacuum, but it does not explicitly disclose a grip unit with a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber to generate a vacuum between a suction plate and an object.

overall.why: The reference describes a system for automated geometric measurement of objects using gripping means, optical means, and comparison means, which is a related field to vacuum handling apparatus but does not disclose the specific features of a vacuum generating device, hollow grip portion, exhaust air
